dog.description_text: Hey there — I'm Chance, a 6-month-old black and white terrier mix with a distinctive white chest! 🐾 I'm still a young pup learning the ropes, so I'm likely to play a bit rough and I'm still working on my manners — but that's where you come in! I can be a little timid at first, but don't let that fool you — I warm up quickly once I get comfortable and feel safe with you. 💙 My adoption fee is $70, and I'm ready to find my forever home where I can grow into the best boy I can be. Let's meet! 🎉
dog.name: Jellybean
